review: gate round 27: independent freeze review of the v25 staging privacy gate (D55 commit, fork, join)
records_note: the merged 18-part run's figures stand; before using its records as freeze evidence check each for controls on, joint on, the printout at the pinned digest, the 75 expected pins and no prefix-only reading, or re-run on the fixed tool state

findings.title: HASH-2 passes without the Rust s25 W-2 table
findings.scenario: ZK60_S25_W2_PRINTOUT unset or naming a missing file -> load_rust returns None -> HASH-2 checks only the gate-side conditions, HC-7 is dropped, the part is true -> D55-PASS. records/d55-first-r13-rung-s0.json (TS lane pass 1) is D55-PASS 16/16 with 'not_compared'; in the same pass the only HASH-2 finding on the 8B bundles was this lookup (the L = 3 parameters absorb, 317 B), so the L = 2..9 finding would have been D55-PASS everywhere without the variable.
findings.fix: At an R13 base make the printout mandatory (absent or unreadable -> HASH-2 false); run HC-7 always.

findings.title: The s25 printout is an unpinned, operator-chosen file
findings.scenario: Any file named by ZK60_S25_W2_PRINTOUT is the 'Rust census'; an edited or foreign printout listing more kinds makes the lookup pass. Its sha256 is recorded but compared with nothing; s25_tests.rs is in no pin list; the wrapper's comment claims a digest check that neither the wrapper nor the gate performs.
findings.fix: Pin the printout's sha256 in the gate (like TS_TRAINED_PIN) and refuse any other; record and read the s25_tests.rs digest that made it.

findings.title: --no-joint and --no-controls still give D55-PASS
findings.scenario: --no-joint: D55-J (ruling M-8's run-level joint rank, the one D55-specific obligation) is not run and not a part; status D55-PASS. --no-controls: no negative control anywhere and status D55-PASS; the record does not say so beyond missing keys.
findings.fix: Cap the status at D55-DEV-PASS (or a status of its own) when joint or controls is false; write controls_run / joint_run into the record.

findings.title: D55-PASS ignores not_here
findings.scenario: (a) The four round-26 bundles and first-r13-rung-s0 are D55-PASS while not_here lists NL-1, the full preimage (and at round 26 TS-1, the census, the hash census); D60's 'until a PASS record exists' was met by records owing four privacy items. (b) W16 family: D55-PASS needs only the eight W16 parts while not_here lists T-0, NL-1, TS-1/census, full preimage, hash census; unreachable today only because the test-only fork writer records no proved_on_gpu (w16_privacy_gate_tests.rs:1966).
findings.fix: D55-PASS only when every not_here entry is a named accepted residual (constant list citing its decision row); cap the W16 family at DEV-PASS.

findings.title: The declared pin list is never checked for completeness
findings.scenario: The real rung manifest with 69 of 75 pins removed (kept: argument, layout, plane_index, protocol, pad, shape) gives PINS ok and an admissible backend; removed: run_fork.rs, run_fork_wire.rs, run_capture.rs, zkp-core pcs.rs / rng.rs, gpu/metal.rs, metal_kernels.metal. D55-0 does not hash manifest.json. W16 family: an empty list passes.
findings.fix: Hold the expected pin set per writer (the 75 files of OWN_SOURCE_FILES + SHARED_SOURCE_FILES of the read run_capture.rs 10b6d3be; the test-only writer's three extras) and require exactly that set; require a known manifest 'writer'.

findings.title: A 48-bit prefix still reads run.rs and run_capture.rs
findings.scenario: W16_READINGS run.rs b9b40cadef4a and run_capture.rs d10d33e3e04f have no R26 reading at the same prefix, so a digest sharing those 12 hex digits is 'read here' and PINS is ok (prefix + 52 zeros, both files). Contradicts r26readings' 'a 48-bit prefix alone never reads a pin'; P-1 targets only R26-read pins. Cost about 2^48 SHA-256.
findings.fix: Full digests in W16_READINGS matched by equality, or no prefix branch for D55 bundles; a P-3 control on a W16-read pin.

findings.title: ZK60_NL_CHECK_DIR can replace later-imported gate modules
findings.scenario: The directory goes to sys.path[0] for the rest of the process; d55hash / d55ts are imported after NL-1. A directory with the two pinned NL files plus a zk60_native_rg_d55hash.py passes load_nl, and the driver then imports that file; tool_sha256 still shows the staging digest.
findings.fix: Load nl_check by file location without sys.path (or remove it after); import part modules at the top of d55_gate; hash loaded modules' __file__ into tool_sha256; record the variable.

findings.title: receipt/tail.bin is not bound to d55_tail.json
findings.scenario: The tail frame (every boundary and endpoint opening) is checked only against the manifest's file hash; d55_tail.json has no segment_bytes / segment_sha256, unlike the fork stage files; the Rust checks compare only tail JSON shapes. A writer that publishes a tail frame other than the one recorded would pass. No current bundle affected (run_fork_tests.rs:1227-1232 writes the verified frames).
findings.fix: Record the tail frame's length and sha256 in d55_tail.json and check it as for the forks; better, decode the frames.

findings.title: The backend rule trusts proved_on_gpu and ignores the writer identity
findings.scenario: W-1 / W-2: proved_on_gpu is the capturing process's enabled() at write time. The gate never reads the manifest's 'writer', which today is what distinguishes an in-process registered capture. A future CLI-child D55 capture would be admitted on the capture process's value.
findings.fix: Rust latches the backend per proof and records the prover's own; the gate requires writer == the registered in-process writer, else UNKNOWN.

findings.title: The r19b reference manifest is an unpinned input
findings.scenario: --r19b-manifest naming a later tree's manifest_final, or an edited manifest_final_r19b.sha256 found by the upward walk, makes every moved pin 'at r19b' with no reading; the record keeps only the path.
findings.fix: Pin the r19b manifest's sha256 in the gate; refuse others; record the digest.

findings.title: Two controls count as fired without an object
findings.scenario: P-1 / P-2 are fires: True when no pin uses an R26 reading; TS-1F is all([]) = true when no TS-1 row has at most ZK60_D55TS_FIDELITY_ROWS data rows (0 makes it vacuous everywhere). D12a's rule: no object = NOT APPLICABLE, none applicable = not a pass.
findings.fix: fires: None for no object; at least one applicable per family; refuse a fidelity limit below 1.

findings.title: J-C5 is optional and its premise unchecked
findings.scenario: Without --other J-C5 drops silently out of 'applicable'; with an --other of another profile or shape the replay fails at the header and the control 'fires' for an unrelated reason. --other feeds no figure.
findings.fix: Require other.profile == b.profile and a different run_binding; name the expected failure site; require --other for a record.

findings.title: The independently checked readings are still labelled SELF_READ
findings.scenario: 748fe707 checked the three wiring readings; every PASS record still lists the check as owed.
findings.fix: At the freeze, re-label with READINGS_R26_WIRING_CHECK.md as the independent reader; keep the Metal files at CPU-path scope.

findings.title: No unit test of the status computation; exit code and record overwrite
findings.scenario: Nothing calls d55_gate's status logic with stubbed parts (the lane blocks are checked as text only); main exits 0 for PASS and DEV-PASS; a record of the same name is overwritten silently.
findings.fix: Stub-part status tests for every flag combination with the FR25-01/03/04 fixes; a distinct exit code for DEV-PASS; refuse to overwrite.

findings.title: Per-fork own calibration: d_max / norm_wrho not re-derived; an out-of-class own shift crashes the run
findings.scenario: Inherited from v24 (r13blocks.py:323-324); both fail closed (no record, or a broken terminal).
findings.fix: Re-derive as stagecal.stage_shapes (SC-7); catch the ValueError into R13-3 false.

findings.title: G_k is recovered, not read
findings.scenario: See verdict: sound for the privacy question, a determination not a binding.
findings.fix: Print the denominator in the D55 stage line (bound through the schedule digest) and compare.

findings.title: S1-S5 on the 16 slots R13 does not redefine never computed at a D55 base shape
findings.scenario: S1's extension-round premise and per-variable bound depend on each slot's (main, extension) split, which differs at 8B T128, Shieldstral T256 and TinyLlama T128 from D33's T32. Evidence gap, not a gate bug.
findings.fix: Run d55_nl1 with SLOTS7 widened to range(23) (legacy ports via T.PORTS; the bilinear eq point as r13blocks.py:237-242) on fork 1 of d55-r13_8b_t128_h24-s0, d55-r13_shield_t256_h24-s0, d55-r13_tiny_t128_low-s0; about 5 min each at the cpu class.

findings.title: TS-1 and the census re-read the bundle from disk without the manifest check
findings.scenario: With a 78-min record, a file changed after D55-0 would be ranked unchecked; the inline-mode cache keys roles by path.
findings.fix: Pass the loaded documents to TS, or re-hash each file against the manifest; key the cache by digest.

verdicts.Q1_fail_open: a FALSE part never gives D55-PASS; an ABSENT or SKIPPED one can (FR25-01, -03, -04, -11, -12); not_here never enters the status
verdicts.Q2_controls: the traced controls mutate the object the real check reads and restore it; exceptions FR25-06 (P-1 blind to W16 prefix readings), FR25-11, FR25-12; no control removes a pin or drops the printout
verdicts.Q3_binding: replay and rank figures are bound to the bundle's transcript; --other feeds only J-C5; unbound or partly bound: the printout (FR25-01/02), ZK60_NL_CHECK_DIR (FR25-07), the r19b manifest (FR25-10), the pin list (FR25-05), tail.bin (FR25-08); the Python gate reads no HL_* variable
verdicts.Q4_pins_and_backend: R26 readings require the full digest (correct); two W16 entries still read on a 48-bit prefix (FR25-06); backend rule: missing -> UNKNOWN refused, non-boolean refused, true refused, false admissible even with no Metal pin (FR25-05)
verdicts.W-1: agree: Medium, latent; no recorded D55 bundle affected (in-process writer); live at the first CLI-child D55 capture; fix FR25-09
verdicts.W-2: agree: Low; needs --ignored without --exact or --include-ignored with >1 thread; the gate cannot see it; fix in Rust (latch)
verdicts.G_k_recovered: sound for the privacy question: only SC_FZC depends on G, exactly one value in 17..24 must close it, G enters public coefficients only; not a binding to the statement (the verifier's job); hardening FR25-16
verdicts.NL1_16_slots_on_D33: still valid at D55 by the D58 argument (define byte-identical; per-fork M and generator; R13-3 23/23 every fork; S3 and the mask budget at all 23 slots); S1/S4/S5 of the 16 bodies unmeasured at the D55 base shapes (FR25-17, exact run given)
verdicts.own_shift_sh_s: no path to a wrong PASS found: fork_calibrations copies the v24 classifier port that closed 23/23 on 25 real Shieldstral blocks carrying own sh_s / sh_ao / sh_h / cn_a / cn_m; clauses are bound through the registered schedule digest; a wrong application fails closed; residual FR25-15; untested on a D55 bundle
verdicts.hash_census_coverage: the L classes are closed (076a485f); no other length class found: every other absorb, column digest and seed-domain length is fixed by the registered shape (per-fork seed domain uses le64(k)); a future variable run base (e.g. product shift 9 vs 10) would add one, caught only by the printout lookup (FR25-01)
